aboutSubtitle: Muryar ku. Gaskiyar ku. An kare.
aboutSubtitleTechnical: Muryar Ku. Gaskiyar Ku. An Kare ta Hanyar Ƙira.
missionPara1: VocalWitness filin jama'a ne mai sauƙi inda kowa zai iya raba abin da ya gani ko ya fuskanta — tare da hujjar cewa ba a canza shi ba.
missionPara2: A duniyar da ke cike da bidiyon da aka gyara da ƙaryar labarai, muna ba mutane na yau da kullum wuri mai aminci don bugawa hotuna, bayanan murya da rahotanni. Komai an kare shi don shaida ta ci gaba da zama abin dogaro kuma sirrinku ya kasance lafiya.
aboutSecuredBy: An kare shi da fasaha mai ƙarfi:
forensicIntegrityTitle: Hujjar cewa Ba a Canza Kome ba
forensicIntegrityDesc: Kowane hoto, bayanan murya da takarda yana samun alamar dijital ta musamman a na'urarku kafin a ɗora. Wasu za su iya tabbatar da cewa gaskiya ne ba tare da ganin bayanan sirrinku ba.
privacyFirstDesc: Magana koyaushe zaɓinku ne. Muna cire wurin da bayanan na'ura ta atomatik. Binciken wayar hannu na ɗan lokaci ne kawai don hana spam kuma ba a taɓa ajiye su a fili ba.
communityStewardshipDesc: Babu mutum ɗaya da ke yanke hukunci akan abin da gaskiya ne. Aminci yana girma ta hanyar shiga cikin gaskiya da bayyanannen suna. Muna tsaye a tsakiya.
communitySupportedDesc: Ana kiyaye VocalWitness ta hanyar tallafin son rai. Babu tallace-tallace, babu bangon biya, kuma babu fasaloli na musamman da aka kulle.
howWeBuildTrust: Yadda Aminci Yake Aiki a Nan
trustStep1Title: 1. Fara da Sauƙi, Girima da Ƙarfi
trustStep1Desc: Kowa yana farawa a matsayin Ɗan Ƙasa. Kuna iya haɓaka matakin ku da bincike mai sauƙi. Matakai mafi girma suna buɗe kariya mai ƙarfi.
trustStep2Desc: Da zarar an buga wani abu, an kulle shi. Babu wanda zai iya canza ko share asali a ɓoye.
trustStep3Desc: VocalWitness filin jama'a ne na tsakiya. Ba mu gyara post ɗin ba kuma ba mu tura wasu labarai ba. Shaida tana magana da kanta.
aboutQuote: "A zamanin hayaniya, murya mafi haske ita ce wadda za ta iya tabbatar da cewa ba a taɓa canza ta ba."
privacySubtitle: An kare sirrinku da fasaha mai ƙarfi — ba kawai alkawura ba.
zkSubpoenaTitle: Ba Za Mu Iya Bayar da Abin da Ba Mu Da Shi ba
zkSubpoenaDesc: An gina VocalWitness ne don cewa shaidar mutum ba ta taɓa isa ga sabobin mu ba. Idan wata hukuma ta nemi bayanan sirrinku, amsar mu mai sauƙi ce: Ba mu da abin da za mu bayar.
privacySec1Title: 1. Komai Mai Muhimmanci Yana Faruwa a Na'urarku
privacySec1Para1: Lokacin da kuka ɗora hoto, bayanan murya ko takarda, aiki mai mahimmanci yana faruwa a cikin burauzarku kafin kome ya fita daga na'urarku:
privacySec1Bullet1: Ana cire bayanan da ke ɓoye: Samfurin kyamara, wurin GPS da sauran bayanan sirri ana share su ta atomatik.
privacySec1Bullet2: Ana ƙirƙirar alamar dijital: Burauzarku yana ƙirƙirar alama ta musamman ta fayil ɗin. Wannan alama da kafofin watsa labarai da aka tsaftace kawai ake aika.
privacySec1Bullet3: Tabbatarwa mai ƙarfi: Kuna iya tabbatar da cewa mutum ne na gaske ba tare da bayyana bayanan shaidar sirrinku ba.
privacySec2Title: 2. Abin da Ba Mu Taɓa Tattara ko Ajiye ba
privacySec2Intro: Don mafi girman tsaro, da gangan ba mu ajiye:
privacySec2Item1: Ainihin adireshin IP ɗinku — buƙatun suna wucewa ta hanyoyin kariya don wurinku ba ya haɗe da post ɗinku.
privacySec2Item2: Lambobin waya a kowace littafin jama'a — binciken wayar hannu na ɗan lokaci ne kawai don hana spam kuma ba a taɓa ajiye ko nuna su ba.
privacySec2Item3: Katin shaida na gwamnati, fasfo, bayanan biometrik ko jerin lambobin sadarwa na mutum.
privacySec3Title: 3. Abin da Muke Sarrafa (Kawai Abin da ake Buƙata)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Sunan mai amfani da kuka zaɓa, maɓallan tsaro da duk wani alamar aminci da kuka samu.
privacyContentDesc: Rahotanninku, kafofin watsa labarai da aka tsaftace, alamomin dijital da tambarin lokaci.
privacyVerificationDesc: Hujjar cewa mutum ne na gaske — ba tare da bayyana wanene ka ba.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Bayanan fasaha da ba a san su ba da ake amfani da su kawai don toshe hare-hare da bots.
privacySec4Title: 4. Ya Yi Daidai da Haƙƙoƙin Ɗan Adam na Duniya
privacySec4Text: Ƙirar mu tana bin Matakai na 12 da 19 na Sanarwar Duniya ta Haƙƙoƙin Ɗan Adam: kowa yana da haƙƙin sirri da 'yancin raba bayanai ba tare da tsoma baki ba.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness kawai mai ɗaukar hoto ne na fasaha. Ba mu rubuta, yarda ko bincika abun ciki da mutane ke bugawa ba.
privacySec5Text2: Kowane mutum yana da cikakken alhakin abin da ya zaɓa ya buga.
privacySec6Title: 6. Abin da Ba a Yarda ba da Yadda ake Bayar da Rahoto
privacySec6Text1: Zalunci, raba bayanan sirri na wani ba tare da izini ba, kayan cin zarafin jima'i na yara da kafofin watsa labarai na ƙarya da gangan an haramta su sosai.
privacySec6Text2: Idan kun ga abun ciki da ya saba wa waɗannan dokoki, da fatan za a ba da rahoto ta amfani da maɓallin da ke cikin manhaja.
privacySec7Title: 7. Fita da Sauri da Littafai na Dindindin
privacySec7Text: Kuna iya share bayanan burauza na gida nan take da maɓallin Fita da Sauri. Duk da haka, da zarar an buga rahoto kuma an kulle shi, ya zama littafi na dindindin.
privacySec8Text: Dandalin VocalWitness, ciki har da software ɗinsa, ƙira, suna da tambari, haƙƙin mallaka na hankali ne na VocalWitness kaɗai. Ba za ku iya kwafi ko sake amfani da shi ba tare da izini ba.
termsIntro: Barka da zuwa VocalWitness — filin jama'a inda mutane za su iya raba rahotanni na gaske da shaida tare da kariya mai ƙarfi. Ta amfani da dandamali kun yarda da waɗannan dokoki masu sauƙi.
termsSection1Text: Ta hanyar ƙirƙirar asusu, bugawa ko amfani da VocalWitness, kun yarda da waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da Manufar Sirrin mu. Idan ba ku yarda ba, da fatan za a daina amfani da dandamali.
termsSection2Title: 2. Rawar Mu – Filin Jama'a na Tsakiya
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness dandamali ne na tsakiya. Muna ba mutane kayan aiki don bugawa rahotanni da kare shaida. Ba mu mawallafin labarai ba, ba mu yanke hukunci akan abin da gaskiya ne ba kuma ba mu kotu ba.
termsSection3Intro: Don kiyaye filin daga bots da spam, muna amfani da matakai masu sauƙi na tabbatarwa:
termsTier1: Tattaunawa a Filin Gani — Buɗe ga duk wanda ya yi rajista. Tattaunawar jama'a ta asali.
termsTier2: Da'irar 'Yan Ƙasa — Ana buɗe ta da binciken wayar hannu na ɗan lokaci (ana amfani da ita kawai don hana spam). Ba a taɓa ajiye lambar wayarku a fili ba.
termsTier3: Babban Aminci / Rahotanni da aka Tabbatar — Mafi girman mataki. Kafofin watsa labarai naku suna samun alamar dijital a na'urarku, ana cire bayanan sirri, kuma ana amfani da kariya mai ƙarfi.
termsSection4Intro: Kuna ci gaba da sarrafa muryarku. Anan ga dokoki masu sauƙi:
termsConduct1: Zaɓinku: Kuna yanke shawarar ko za ku yi magana a fili ko ku kasance da ƙarin sirri.
termsConduct2: Ku Kasance da Gaskiya: Ku buga kawai rahotanni da shaida da kuke gaskanta da gaske.
termsConduct3: Babu Doxxing ko Zalunci: Kada ku raba bayanan sirri na wasu. Ba a yarda da zalunci mai niyya ba.
termsConduct4: Babu Abun Ciki na Ƙarya ko Mai Cutarwa: Ƙirƙirar deepfakes don cutar da wani an haramta shi sosai.
termsSection5Text: Kuna riƙe cikakken mallakar duk abin da kuka buga. Ta bugawa, kuna ba VocalWitness izinin ajiye da nuna abun cikinku. Da zarar an kulle shi, ya zama ɓangare na littafi na dindindin.
termsSection6Title: 6. Fasahar da Muke Amfani da Ita
termsSection6Text: Muna amfani da ayyuka na duniya masu aminci don ajiye mai aminci da kariya daga hare-hare. Ana bayar da dandamali “kamar yadda yake”.
termsSection7Title: 7. Yadda VocalWitness Yake Ci gaba da Zama Kyauta
termsSection7Text: Ana tallafawa dandamali ta hanyar gudummawar son rai. Gudummawa ba ta ba kowa iko na musamman ko mallaka ba.
termsSection8Text: Zuwa mafi girman iyakar doka ta yarda, VocalWitness ba shi da alhakin cututtuka na kai tsaye da ke fitowa daga amfani da dandamali ko abun ciki da masu amfani suka buga.
termsSection9Title: 9. Alhakinku ga Abin da Kuka Buga
termsSection9Text: Kuna da alhakin abin da kuka buga. Idan wani yana da matsala da abun ciki, ya kamata ya yi amfani da tsarin bayar da rahoto naku.
termsSection10Text: Duk haƙƙoƙin dandalin VocalWitness, ciki har da software ɗinsa, ƙira, suna da tambari, suna ci gaba da zama mallakar VocalWitness kaɗai.
termsSection10Text2: Ba za ku iya kwafi, gyara ko yin amfani da wani ɓangare na dandamali don kasuwanci ba tare da izini na rubutu ba.
divineNaturalLawDesc: Kowane mutum yana da haƙƙin raba abin da ya gani. An kare wannan ƙarƙashin Mataki na 19 na Sanarwar Duniya ta Haƙƙoƙin Ɗan Adam.
subpoenaDefenseTitle: 1. Kariya Mai Ƙarfi ta Hanyar Ƙira
subpoenaDefenseDesc: Ba za mu iya bayar da bayanan da ba mu taɓa tattara ba. Shaidar ku tana ci gaba da karewa.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: Babu rajistan shaida da ke haɗe da post ɗinku na jama'a.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: Ana cire wuri da bayanan na'ura a burauzarku kafin ɗorawa.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Kariya mai ƙarfi ta fasaha ga masu ba da rahoto a ɓoye.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Ƙarin Shawarwari na Tsaro don Yanayi Masu Haɗari
networkSafetySubDesc: A wurare masu ƙuntatawa, yi amfani da Tor ko VPN mai aminci. Guje wa bugawa a kan hanyoyin sadarwa da ke haɗe da shaidar ku ta hukuma.
physicalSafetySub: Tsaron Na'ura da Fita da Sauri
physicalSafetySubDesc: Yi amfani da lambar sirri mai ƙarfi. Idan kun ji haɗari, danna maɓallin ja na Fita da Sauri — yana share bayanan gida kuma yana barin rukunin yanar gizo.
safetySection2Title: 3. Abin da Ba a Yarda ba
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Raba bayanan sirri na wani ba tare da izini ba.
safetyProhibit3: Shaida na Ƙarya ko da aka Canza da nufin cutar da wasu.
safetySection4Title: 4. Yadda Muke Kiyaye Al'umma da Tsaro
safetySection4Text: Tsaro yana zuwa daga rahotannin al'umma da bayyanannun matakan tabbatarwa:
safetyModTier1: Tattaunawa a Filin Gani — Tattaunawa a buɗe ga kowa.
safetyModTier2: Babban Aminci — Kariya mai ƙarfi da suna.
safetyGoalText: Filin jama'a mai aminci inda za a iya raba rahotanni na gaske kuma a kare mutane ta hanyar ƙira.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Da zarar an buga rahoto, dokoki suna sa ya zama da wahala sosai ga kowa ya gyara ko ya share asali.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Dokokin bayanan bayanai suna toshe sabuntawa da sharewa a littafin.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Ana ƙirƙirar alamomin dijital a na'urarku.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Ana haɗa littafai tare don ƙarin kariya.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Muhimmi: Wannan kariya ce mai ƙarfi a matakin manhaja, ba cikakken blockchain na jama'a ba. Bayanai suna zaune a ajiye gajeren yanayi mai aminci.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Zaɓi na gaba: Za mu iya ƙara ƙarin ankan jama'a. Wannan ba a kunna shi ba tukuna.
